page_summary: The report aims to enhance cybersecurity and resilience in maritime transport for port authorities and operators. It presents adaptable guidance tailored to diverse port ecosystems and acknowledges varying responsibilities across jurisdictions. The findings are based on a mixed-methods approach, including a global survey of 109 stakeholders and expert interviews, providing insights into cybersecurity practices across different income groups.
